name: TV4-a-cloud-that-does-not-fall-stands-a-veil
note: Fog banks and fair-weather cloud hang rain curtains over a dry valley - weather invented.

name: TV4-reach-from-the-middle
note: A storm whose rim is in the view but whose middle is not stands no curtain.

name: TV4-no-fade-over-it
note: The eye over a storm sees the inside of a solid tube - VC7c's `near` law broken.

name: TV4-foot-floats
note: A curtain over a valley floor lower than the traveller hangs above the ground with daylight under it.

name: TV4-no-cap
note: A front of twenty storm cells is twenty full-screen blended passes.

name: TV4-furthest-first
note: The cap keeps the far curtains and drops the storm beside the traveller.

name: TV4-clip-ignored
old: if (c.clip && Math.hypot(c.x - c.clip[0], c.z - c.clip[1]) > c.clip[2]) continue;
note: A storm's cell outside the disc its front paints within stands a curtain in clear sky.

name: TV4-back-faces-count
old: float c = len > 1e-3 ? max(0.0, dot(vNormal, toEye / len)) : 0.0;
new: float c = len > 1e-3 ? abs(dot(vNormal, toEye / len)) : 0.0;
note: Every curtain doubled by its own far side - and no winding under the mirrored lens decides which.

name: TV4-unfogged
old: float a = (1.0 - exp(-tau)) * top * uAlpha * fogFactorAt(vWorld);
note: A curtain two leagues off through rain fog stands as sharp as one beside the road.

name: TV4-fog-from-the-camera
old: if (U.uFocus) gl.uniform4fv(U.uFocus, fog?.focus ?? NO_FOCUS);   // TV1's focus: the fog is the traveller's
note: The veils fogged from 450 m up while the ground under them is fogged from the traveller.

name: TV4-curtains-at-the-eye-too
note: At the eye the sky map's curtains are drawn twice over - once in the sky, once standing in it.

name: TV4-strike-from-the-raised-eye
old: eye: tvf ? cam.pos : mwv.eye, distant: struckFar,
note: Under the view every strike's channel ends 448 m above the ground it should hit.

name: AUDIT-TV-D1-light-faded
old: { light: lit, fade: Math.min(1, tvf.blend * 1.5), fog:
note: The rise darkens the curtains' colour at full opacity: black veils over the land while the camera climbs.

name: AUDIT-TV-D1-fade-ignored
note: The curtains pop in whole on the first frame of the rise.

name: AUDIT-TV-D2-eye-only
old: const e = Math.min(Math.hypot(c.x - eye[0], c.z - eye[2]), Math.hypot(c.x - focus[0], c.z - focus[2]));
new: const e = Math.hypot(c.x - eye[0], c.z - eye[2]);
note: The traveller inside a storm with the eye outside it is seen through the whole cylinder's chord.

name: AUDIT-TV-D3-foot-traveller-only
old: const foot = Math.min(g - CURTAIN_BELOW_M, lowestGround(groundAt, c.x, c.z, radius) - CURTAIN_FOOT_MARGIN_M);
note: A storm over a valley deeper than 300 m under the traveller hangs its foot in the air.

name: AUDIT-TV-D3-no-land-handed
note: The host never hands the land: the lowest-ground rule is dead weight.

name: AUDIT-TV-D3-rim-unasked
note: Only the centre is asked: a valley at the veil's rim is missed.
